FaceID nonce consumption, tenant/account/application checks and shared extra MFA; legacy FaceID response receipt preserved.

Normal multipart upload/resource/transcript APIs support Local and S3, 32 MiB file bound and 2 MiB preview bound.
Range, ignored Range, unknown length, failure atomicity, old version preservation and repeated tenant boundary checks.
commerce: Durable inventory reservations before remote checkout; order locks and payment reuse across instances.
Verified callbacks and authorized administrator settlement share idempotent inventory, ledger and coupon finalization.
Immutable terminal states and checkout snapshots enforced for REST and compatibility CRUD with named database constraints.
Public callback routes verify provider signatures, references, amounts and currency; manual state changes require a matching tenant administrator.
Own-order pay/cancel permissions allow buyers while rejecting peer users and foreign tenants.

frontend: Marketplace provider client credentials and optional application binding; preview changes clear secrets.
Real browser application/provider installation, persisted linkage and uninstall through a checksummed local HTTP catalog.

deployment_contract: Apply migrations 027 and 028 before serving this version. Stop old application writers during rollout; they do not participate in checkout lifecycle enforcement.

Migration 028 locks orders, payments and products, validates pending order/payment/product snapshots and aggregate stock, and fails atomically when existing data requires reconciliation. It does not silently remove pending purchases.
A TOTP setup proof cannot be reused during the same accepted step to log in. Use a later authenticator step or a distinct recovery code.
Configure Stripe webhook secret or PayPal verification webhook ID for real notifications. Unsigned/unconfigured verification does not settle payments.
remaining: LDAP and email/SMS-code primary authentication, trusted FaceID capture/liveness and real Kerberos verification.
Key application/service principals and API credential authentication, Agent proxy execution, full OpenClaw/OTLP.
Priced plans and recharge purchasing, auto-renewal scheduler, cart and dedicated commerce UI.
Remote void/refund, automatic reconciliation and recovery of unknown checkout outcomes, and PayPal capture.
Specialized CRUD/import side effects including imported password hashes, complete pagination/filtering semantics.
Runtime application of operational settings, additional storage/payment/messaging/synchronization providers.
Marketplace theme installation/cache/fallback catalog, broader dedicated UI, localization and organizational customization.
Real cloud storage/vendors, hardware/browser matrix, SAML interoperability and production multi-host/deployment acceptance.
